'''Leelu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] member of the [[Torgaigne]] crime syndicate, active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Attahox]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A hulking, mute henchman of the Torgaigne gangster [[Vor Childermoss]], Leelu was at Childermoss' side when his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] entered the mysterious section of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]] in pursuit of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Upon entering the Hellhoop, they were all captured by a reclusive evil-worshipping cult called the [[Five]]. Once aboard the Five's [[Five's warship|ship]], Leelu was brutally [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Five member [[Mavin]].<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Leelu appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Leelu was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" />
